recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多個中到大型的異常前骨髓細胞，核呈雙葉、摺疊或蝴蝶形（bilobed），細胞質淡紫、顆粒細小不明顯，視野中看不到 Auer 小體，符合微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）；右下另有一個顆粒粗大、正在破裂的細胞。
features: Numerous medium to large abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed, folded or butterfly-shaped nuclei
Moderate lilac cytoplasm with sparse, fine dust-like granules (hypogranular); no Auer rods identified in this field
One disrupted cell (lower right) with coarse purple-red granules spilling from the cytoplasm
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytes); platelets markedly decreased
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocytosis composed of medium to large abnormal cells with bilobed, folded or butterfly-shaped nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale lilac cytoplasm containing only fine, inconspicuous granules. No Auer rods are identified in this field, and one disrupted cell with coarse azurophilic granules is present. Platelets are markedly reduced and background red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent PML::RARA confirmation and coagulation studies are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, are strongly nonspecific esterase positive and HLA-DR positive, whereas microgranular APL cells are strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR/CD34 negative.
Classic APL cells are packed with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and often contain faggot cells, while the microgranular variant shows sparse fine granules and high WBC.
NPM1-mutated AML may be HLA-DR/CD34 negative but lacks bilobed promyelocytes and PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell or large cell lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells are MPO negative with basophilic or hairy cytoplasm and B- or T-cell markers.
